review_candidates.title: Microsoft 365 Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for configuring, administering, and optimizing Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and related security and compliance features. The specialist will work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and support users through training, documentation, and troubleshooting. Daily responsibilities include monitoring system performance, managing user access and license
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Microsoft 365 Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt.
Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, with strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to inclusive, professional conduct.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The specialist will work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and support users through training, documentation, and troubleshooting. Qualifications Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams. Background in consulting or internal advisory roles, supporting stakeholders in defining requirements and delivering tailored Microsoft 365 solutions. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 (e.g., Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive) and managing user access, licenses, and policies.
